currentParagraphText: “Excuse me, Hall Master?” one of Viridia’s assistants spoke as he teleported into the room, shaking the Verdant Witch out of her thoughts.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “What is it?” Viridia asked, turning to the dragonkin as she wondered if more guests had arrived to try and form good relations with the Order of the Malefic Viper.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: She couldn’t help but consider if she should perhaps visit herself, as even if she wasn’t an alchemist, it would be good to have a better understanding of the World Wonder, but just then, she was interrupted.
